svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.aria-label: symcc demo: you are the team lead. You talk to the lead, it plans tasks, workers build them in parallel in their own copies, checks and tests run, you see the change and approve it, and it merges. Then a scout wakes up on its timer, finds code without tests and reports it; the lead adds a task, a worker does it, you approve it and it is merged.
svg.title: symcc demo
